subject.title: Allow Telegram reply documents and EPUB media

question: Should unconfigured Telegram reply attachments receive a larger default staging limit, and if so should that exception be limited to validated document attachments rather than every reply-media source?
rationale: The branch changes an existing default at a security-sensitive file-read and memory/staging boundary; source evidence supports the need for document delivery but does not establish that a blanket 100 MB Telegram fallback is the intended durable contract.

options.title: Use a document-only Telegram exception
options.body: Rebase the PR and select the Telegram document cap only after validated attachment classification, retaining the existing default for images, video, and unknown media.

options.title: Keep the generic fallback
options.body: Retain the existing 5 MB unconfigured staging default and require users to use the existing configured media limit where larger files are needed.

options.title: Adopt a broader channel-level default
options.body: Approve a documented Telegram-wide default increase with explicit memory, transport, and upgrade tests for all attachment kinds.

recommendation.title: Use a document-only Telegram exception
recommendation.body: Rebase the PR and select the Telegram document cap only after validated attachment classification, retaining the existing default for images, video, and unknown media.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main ownership could not be reliably reconstructed from the available read-only evidence, so the decision should be routed to the current media/Telegram area owner.
